"""Run the complete current flake gate with tracked sources and staged diff frozen."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/home/josh/projects/klem')
output = Path('/tmp/klem-ostensible-reason-combined-nix.json')
log = output.with_suffix('.log')
assert not output.exists() and not log.exists()

def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def staged_digest():
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git','diff','--cached','--binary','--no-ext-diff','--no-textconv'],cwd=ROOT,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    while chunk := process.stdout.read(1048576):
        result.update(chunk)
    assert process.wait()==0
    return result.hexdigest()

head = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
staged = staged_digest()
names = subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z'],cwd=ROOT).decode().split('\0')[:-1]
snapshot = {name:{'sha256':digest((ROOT/name).read_bytes()),'bytes':(ROOT/name).stat().st_size} for name in names}
package = json.loads((ROOT/'docs/ostensible-reason-package-nix.json').read_text())
assert package['state']=='passed'
assert all(snapshot[name]==record for name,record in package['snapshot']['files'].items())
source_profiles = {}
for name in ['klem','web-assets','corpus-adapter','inventory-review']:
    source = subprocess.check_output(['nix','eval','--offline','--raw',f'.#checks.x86_64-linux.{name}.src.outPath'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    source_profiles[name] = source
    for path in Path(source).rglob('*'):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        relative = str(path.relative_to(source))
        if name=='web-assets':
            relative = 'web/'+relative
        assert relative in snapshot and digest(path.read_bytes())==snapshot[relative]['sha256'],(name,relative)
assert source_profiles['klem']==source_profiles['corpus-adapter']==package['source_profiles']['klem']
assert source_profiles['web-assets']==package['source_profiles']['web-assets']
command = ['nix','build','--offline','--option','build-dir','/var/tmp/klem-degree-expectation-nix-build',
           '--cores','4','--max-jobs','2','--no-link','--print-out-paths','-L',
           *[f'.#checks.x86_64-linux.{name}' for name in source_profiles]]
producer = Path(__file__)
receipt = {'schema_version':1,'state':'running','pid':os.getpid(),'started_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           'command':command,'source_profiles':source_profiles,'head':head,'staged_diff_sha256':staged,
           'snapshot':{'files':snapshot},'producer':{'text':producer.read_text(),'sha256':digest(producer.read_bytes())},
           'expected_runtime_outputs':package['outputs'],
           'scope':'All four current flake checks: exact previously tested main Rust/assets and separately built corpus adapter, plus the actual immutable inventory source running all existing and new source/preservation/runtime/performance gates. Every tracked file, HEAD and staged binary diff frozen until terminal. Bounded tracker closure and its final documentation gate remain separate; full coverage/precision/contextual review remain open.'}
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment['TMPDIR'] = '/var/tmp/klem-degree-expectation-nix-build'
with log.open('xb') as stream:
    result = subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=environment,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
receipt.update(state='passed' if result.returncode==0 else 'failed',exit_code=result.returncode,
               snapshot_unchanged=all(digest((ROOT/name).read_bytes())==record['sha256'] for name,record in snapshot.items()),
               head_unchanged=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()==head,
               staged_diff_unchanged=staged_digest()==staged,
               finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),log_sha256=digest(log.read_bytes()),
               outputs=[line for line in log.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('/nix/store/')])
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Complete ostensible-reason Nix gate:',receipt['state'],'exit',result.returncode,'frozen sources/diff:',receipt['snapshot_unchanged'],receipt['staged_diff_unchanged'],flush=True)
assert receipt['snapshot_unchanged'] and receipt['head_unchanged'] and receipt['staged_diff_unchanged']
if result.returncode==0:
    assert set(receipt['expected_runtime_outputs'])<=set(receipt['outputs'])
    assert len(receipt['outputs'])==4
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
